text:
Pastor Donna Rigney speaking with podcast host Kelsey O'Malley

A Floridian MAGA pastor is going viral for claiming that a "portal was opened over the White House and Mar-a-Lago," so that President Donald Trump can "easily be able to get intel from the Holy Spirit."

Donna Rigney, a self-proclaimed "prophetic" pastor and co-founder of the non-denominational church, His Heart Ministries Int., recently joined host Kelsey O'Malley of Christian media organization ElijahStreams, where she made the shocking revelation. According to her website, 'The Glory of God Revealed' author is a frequent guest on the platform.

During her recent podcast appearance, she spoke at length about her belief that God opened a portal over the two residences where Trump spends the majority of his time in order to communicate with him and provide him guidance in his high-stakes leadership role. Her claims come after JD Vance was slammed after he said that he hoped Pope Leo 'learned' something from him and Trump on immigration.

Rigney shared, "When we were all done, the next day, Father explained to me, he said that now that this was opened, this portal was opened over the White House and over Mar-a-Lago, and Donald Trump was going to easily be able to get intel from the Holy Spirit," to which O'Malley replied, "Hallelujah!".

Rigney describes herself on her church's website as "a prophetic author, pastor, intercessor and inspirational speaker whose life flows from a deep and intimate relationship with Jesus" that is "known for her frequent encounters in the spirit and the glory of God, Donna shares profound revelations that inspire others to pursue deeper intimacy with the Holy Spirit."

She continued to tell O'Malley about the revelation she had and a subsequent experience that validated her beliefs.

"That God was going to easily be able to give him wisdom for decisions he has to make, that, this, it's just open, open communication, that, oh, God will easily be able to speak to him, and he'll hear him," Rigney continued. "There'll be nothing getting in the way of him being able to hear, just like Daniel; it took 21 days for him to get the answer, that's not going to happen.

"With an open heaven, immediately, Donald Trump will be able to get direction from God on how to lead the nation, and other presidents after, if they're serving God, they, too, will, with the portal that's open."

She went on to share what she claimed was a validating incident that unfolded in connection with the revelation about Trump.

"Now, we're finishing up where everyone's so—because I explained to them after each song what I saw, and then we shared other people saw things, too," she said. "Somebody felt the Holy Spirit guide them to take a picture of the sky. Toward the bottom in the center of the photo was a brighter light, and, so, as we expanded it, if you look at it closely, you can see a profile of an angel's face, of the angel blowing the debris. That's what I did and was like, 'Wow!'".
